title: Diabies
summary: Succeeded Athothes as king of Thebes. Shuckford gives him a reign of nineteen years.
description: Added from the Shuckford import. Display only. Shuckford’s years are Anno Mundi, or a “years before Christ” figure he is reporting. This chronology never sets a sort, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person’s birth, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Shuckford is display-only).

reign.date: Diabies succeeded him, who reigned nineteen years, and died A. M. 2053
reign.citation: Shuckford, The Sacred and Profane History of the World Connected, 5th ed., revised by James Creighton (London: William Baynes, 1819), vol. 1, Book V, p. 246 (facsimile PDF p. 342)
reign.note: A. M. 2034 is printed as the death of Athothes, at which Diabies succeeded. A. M. 2053 is printed as Diabies’ death. The nineteen years are printed.
